description:
Extend the canonical construction path to explicit-generator `BchSpec` flavors: verify splitting-field compatibility and $g(x) \mid x^n-1$, derive the root set, and reject incompatible generators.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Explicit-generator specs verify compatibility and divisibility, derive the root set in the splitting field, and construct with parameters derived from that root set.
- [hard] REQ-02: Incompatible generators — wrong field, non-divisor, coefficients outside the base field — report typed errors naming the failed check.
title: Construction from explicitly supplied generator polynomials
